correctness.rationale: The proof fixes an arbitrary Young sector and separates the exact low case from the high case. For high sectors it applies the inspected first-column growth inequality uniformly over histories, dominates the successive waiting times by independent geometric variables, evaluates their mean exactly as \(n((r+2)H_r-r)\), and invokes the inspected geometric-sum tail bound. The ideal truncation error is at most \(arepsilon/2\). The inspected pairwise-SWAP realization is then substituted at diamond error \(arepsilon/(2M_r)\) per call; a hybrid bound contributes at most another \(arepsilon/2\). All quantifiers and the permutation-invariant input restriction are explicit.

value.rationale: The closest primary source explicitly motivates reducing local-dimension dependence for partial tasks such as rank testing. The result removes \(d\) entirely from the decision-stage operation count and identifies the structural mechanism: stop at first-column size \(r+1\), omit bottom certification and later columns, and exploit the exact harmonic waiting-time sum.
